query: SELECT plc.id, plc.leaderEmail, plc.leaderName, plc.processId, p.name as processName, c.name as companyName FROM processLeaderCredentials plc JOIN processes p ON plc.processId = p.id JOIN companies c ON p.companyId = c.id WHERE plc.leaderEmail = 'lalitera@yahoo.com';
